- Purple rectangle (5 rows)

2. Then stamp purple rectangle (paints top half purple)

Unless... I need to stamp in a different order or use a different shape. Let me try:
1. Stamp purple rectangle first (fills all purple or paints top half purple)
2. Then stamp white rectangle (paints top half white)
This would give white top + purple bottom!
Let me test this theory.
